attempts.why: Error text #f0a0a0 on white has ~1.5:1 contrast and is unreadable; using --err restores accessible contrast.

selfVerify.reason: Error #err shows rgb(176, 0, 32) on white (~7:1 contrast) not #f0a0a0 (~1.5:1), and viewport 1200 matches docScrollWidth 1200 with no overflow/clipping; header, grid, table-wrap and form layout intact.
